title: Kck Framework Configuration
description: The "Kck" section read by the Kck.Bundle.* packages (AddKckWebApiDefaults, AddKckMinimalApiDefaults, AddKckWorkerServiceDefaults). Providers are configured in code, not from this section. Add '$schema' to your appsettings.json for IDE autocomplete.

Kck.description: Read by the Kck.Bundle.* packages only.

Jwt.description: WebApi and MinimalApi bundles: when Issuer is set, the JWT token service (Kck.Security.Jwt) is registered. It does not configure ASP.NET Core authentication; the RSA signing key is configured in code.

Issuer.description: Token issuer. Setting it enables the token service.

RateLimitPermitLimit.description: Requests per client IP per window.

CorsOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins. Leave out to disable CORS.

Provider.description: Only Quartz is bundled; any other value fails at startup.
